name: Account hacked or lost
description: Reviewers report their accounts were hacked or taken over, leaving them locked out and unable to get support help.

name: App won't open or work
description: Reviewers say the app won't open or function even after reinstalling, clearing data, or resetting their phone.

name: Unexpected logouts and freezes
description: Reviewers report being logged out unexpectedly, after which the app gets stuck on the logo or a loading screen.

name: Cannot log in
description: Reviewers cannot sign in with their email, password, or Facebook login, even with premium accounts.

name: Unfair charges and payment prompts
description: Reviewers feel pressured to pay, with aggressive payment reminders and charges they see as unfair or forced.

name: Paid features feel unfair
description: Reviewers object to features moved behind a paywall, feeling the free service has become less useful.

name: Basic features locked behind premium
description: Reviewers are frustrated that basic controls like shuffle, skip, and replay require a premium subscription.

name: Subscription too expensive
description: Reviewers say the premium subscription costs too much and some say they may cancel because of it.

name: Ads and features tied to premium
description: Reviewers complain that ads persist for free users or that favourite songs and features stop working without premium.

name: Limited or unwanted songs
description: Reviewers feel the song selection is limited and that songs they did not choose appear in their playlists.

name: Lyrics missing or not loading
description: Reviewers report lyrics no longer appear or fail to load, and some feel removing them was unnecessary.

name: Songs and features removed
description: Reviewers notice songs disappearing from the catalogue, some regional features restricted, and playlist songs they cannot find.

name: Podcast and audiobook problems
description: Reviewers report podcasts in the wrong language, unfollowed shows still appearing, and disappointment with audiobooks.

name: Unwanted recommended songs
description: Reviewers say the app adds random recommended songs to playlists and repeats songs they do not want to hear.

name: Hard to find wanted songs
description: Reviewers find search returns the wrong songs, artists are hard to find, and their own lists are difficult to locate.

name: Downloads fail or stop playing
description: Reviewers report downloads failing on new phones or previously downloaded songs not playing after restarts.

name: Downloaded songs deleted
description: Reviewers say many of their downloaded songs were removed, sometimes after updates, and cannot be moved to storage.

name: Local and personal files missing
description: Reviewers say songs and personal lists fail to appear or play without Wi-Fi, and local files do not show up.

name: Offline listening broken
description: Reviewers report offline playback failing, premium benefits not working offline, and downloads cleared without consent.

name: General dissatisfaction with app
description: Reviewers express broad dislike of the app or recent updates, often without describing a specific problem.

name: Poor sound quality
description: Reviewers say the audio sounds poor, songs cut off on mobile, and quality drops after recent updates.

name: Battery and data drain
description: Reviewers say the app runs in the background, drains battery, and uses a lot of data.

name: Connection and car audio issues
description: Reviewers get false no-internet messages, slow performance, and trouble connecting the app to car audio systems.

name: App crashes or freezes
description: Reviewers report the app closing unexpectedly, freezing, or refusing to pause or stop playback.

name: Playback not working properly
description: Reviewers say playback stops working, the app does not stay active in the background, and some features are unsupported.

name: Slow loading and lag
description: Reviewers report the app lagging, taking a long time to load songs, and glitching even with premium.

name: Wrong song plays
description: Reviewers say tapping a favourite song plays a different one, and the app stutters or glitches during playback.

name: Music stops unexpectedly
description: Reviewers report songs stopping on their own, playlists halting after one track, and errors persisting after updates.

name: Poor support and survey annoyance
description: Reviewers feel the company does not respond to feedback and that surveys and premium prompts are intrusive.

name: Customer support unhelpful
description: Reviewers say chat support takes too long, rarely solves problems, and offers no direct customer service options.

name: Too many ads
description: Reviewers complain of frequent ads, including back-to-back ads during songs, making the app frustrating to use.

name: Basic controls and privacy concerns
description: Reviewers report missing basic controls like rewind and sharing, lost search history, and feeling their privacy was breached.

name: Playlists and liked songs hard to use
description: Reviewers say liked songs display blank, playlists play only suggestions, and the like button is harder to find.

name: Can't control song order
description: Reviewers feel unable to skip, unshuffle, or play songs in their chosen order, with unwanted songs auto-playing.

name: Layout changes disliked
description: Reviewers want recent home page and interface changes reverted, including the missing history, heart button, and canvas features.
